name: Klaus Richter
bio:
Klaus Richter's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination with aerodynamics, fueled by his father's work as an engineer. He pursued a degree in aerospace engineering at the Vienna University of Technology, and after graduating, he honed his skills in Formula Student before landing a role at a smaller racing outfit. There, he quickly made a name for himself by developing innovative aero solutions that helped the team punch above their weight.

Klaus joined Hitech GP five years ago, and his impact has been significant. He has a hands-on approach to aero development, preferring to be on the shop floor working directly with the engineers. He places a high premium on data-driven decision-making and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. He's known for his ability to identify subtle aerodynamic inefficiencies that others often overlook, and his visionary ideas often push the team to explore unconventional solutions.

What sets Klaus apart is his ability to blend technical expertise with strong leadership skills. He doesn't just dictate; he inspires, empowering his team to take ownership and contribute their best work. He's a firm believer in collaborative problem-solving and always makes time to listen to his team's ideas and concerns. He is constantly looking for new ways to improve the car's performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Klaus is a man of medium build, with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rapidly on the desk when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking herbal tea during every team meeting.
